t: The Blazing Agitator prepares blaze rods for the $(l:rftoolsbase:powergeneration/blazinggenerator)Blazing Generator$(/l). It uses a little FE to turn normal rods into Blazing Rods.
烈焰激活器用于为$(l:rftoolsbase:powergeneration/blazinggenerator)烈焰发电机$(/l)准备烈焰棒。它消耗少量FE，将普通烈焰棒加工为充能烈焰棒。
Nearby rods in the input grid improve each other. Better rods finish faster and gain better power quality, so it pays to keep a few strong rods in the grid.
输入网格中邻近的棒材可相互提升性能。品质更优的棒材完成速度更快、能量质量更佳，因此建议在网格中常备若干强力棒材。
The nine lock buttons keep finished rods from moving to output. Use them to keep high-quality rods in place as boosters for future rods.
九个锁定按钮可防止已完成的棒材移至输出端。请使用它们固定高品质棒材，作为后续棒材的增效助推器。
